skills.description: Concrete technologies, tools, languages and methods required or preferred (max 25). No soft skills.

cloud_platforms.description: Public cloud platforms the role works with.

seniority.description: Seniority level; null if the ad does not indicate one.

salary_min_eur.description: Lower bound of the stated yearly gross salary in EUR; null if no salary is stated.

salary_max_eur.description: Upper bound of the stated yearly gross salary in EUR; null if no salary is stated.

german_level_required.description: German needed for the role: none (not required or not mentioned for an English ad), basic, or fluent (fließend, verhandlungssicher, C1/C2, or a German ad that asks for very good German).

english_only.description: True only if the ad says German is not required or explicitly says English is sufficient.

visa_sponsorship_mentioned.description: True only if the ad mentions visa sponsorship, work permit support or relocation support.

remote_policy.description: Work location model; null if the ad does not say.
